title: Bridging-Induced Phase Separation and Loop Extrusion Drive Noise in Chromatin Transcription.
authors: Chiang, Michael; Battaglia, Cleis; Forte, Giada; Brackley, Chris A; Gilbert, Nick; Marenduzzo, Davide
one_liner_zh: 该文用聚合物模拟研究转录因子结合与染色质环挤压驱动的转录噪声，虽非直接TF-DNA结合建模，但涉及TF-DNA互作动态与三维结构，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作机制研究。
abstract: Cell-to-cell heterogeneity in transcription, or transcriptional noise, is important in cellular development and in disease. The molecular mechanisms driving it are, however, elusive and ill-understood. Here, we use computer simulations to explore the role of 3D chromatin structure in driving transcriptional noise. We study a simple polymer model where proteins-modeling complexes of transcription factors and polymerases-bind multivalently to transcription units-modeling regulatory elements such as promoters and enhancers. We also include cohesinlike factors that extrude chromatin loops that are important for the physiological folding of chromosomes. We find that transcription factor binding creates spatiotemporal patterning and a highly variable correlation time in transcriptional dynamics, which is linked to the cell-to-cell variation in gene expression. Loop extrusion also contributes to noise, as the stochastic nature of this process leads to different networks of cohesin loops in different cells in our model. Our results could be tested with single-cell experiments and provide a pathway to understanding the principles underlying transcriptional plasticity in vivo.
abstract_zh: 转录中的细胞间异质性，即转录噪声，在细胞发育和疾病中具有重要意义。然而，驱动其产生的分子机制仍难以捉摸且理解不足。在此，我们使用计算机模拟来探索3D染色质结构在驱动转录噪声中的作用。我们研究了一个简单的聚合物模型，其中蛋白质——模拟转录因子和聚合酶的复合物——多价结合到转录单元——模拟启动子和增强子等调控元件。我们还纳入了类似黏连蛋白（cohesin）的因子，这些因子挤出染色质环，对染色体的生理折叠至关重要。我们发现，转录因子结合产生了时空模式，并在转录动力学中引入了高度可变的关联时间，这与基因表达的细胞间变异相关。环挤出同样促成噪声，因为该过程的随机性导致我们模型中不同细胞具有不同的黏连蛋白环网络。我们的结果可通过单细胞实验进行验证，并为理解体内转录可塑性的基本原理提供了一条途径。
